An Interactive LitRPG Series

Wonderrot

Wonderland went bad. The Cat is narrating. You are in the glass.

✦
Episode One

The Long Fall

You fall. Something is waiting at the bottom with a list. Pools, doors, a house that should not stand, a wood that remembers your name, and a Queen's Herald with questions. Build a hero, find your gear, and survive the descent.

284 scenesMany endingsMature
Episode Two

The Caterpillar's Smoke

"Who are you?" Bring your Glass Code and your hero walks in as they ended. Gillgarth, the Wood of Names, the Spore Market, the box you buried, and a Wearer who has your face. No code? Arrive as a stranger.

218 scenesCarries your heroMature
Episode Three

The Duchess's Kitchen

Pepper in the air and a cook who throws things. A baby that is not a baby, a pot of a thousand names, and a Cat with a name he has never said. Sneeze at the wrong moment and you lose more than breath.

153 scenesCarries your heroMature
Episode Four

The Mad Tea Party

It is always six o'clock. A Hatter, a Hare, a Dormouse asleep in a teapot, a dream at the bottom of a treacle well, and Time himself, who has never been told he may say no. Spend his Minutes wisely.

135 scenesCarries your heroMature
Episode Five

The Queen's Croquet Ground

Flamingos for mallets, hedgehogs for balls, a Queen who has lost her own name, a Gryphon with a ledger of heads, and a Mock Turtle who is soup. Win her game, and see what she does about it.

110 scenesCarries your heroMature
Episode Six · Finale

The Trial and the Glass

A court. A jury made of everyone you met and what you did to them. Charges you remember and some you do not. And a Glass that has been looking back at you since the first page. Five endings; one of them is a secret.

118 scenes5 endingsMature
